title: Buy Nothing Frame
tagline: A platform designed to facilitate community connections through gifting and sharing on Warpcast.
description: The Buy Nothing Frame platform is a community-centered platform hosted on Warpcast, aimed at fostering connections through gifting and sharing. Users have the freedom to give items freely, ask for what they need, and share resources within their community. By engaging in genuine interactions, the platform aims to foster trust and goodwill among its users, creating a supportive and interconnected community environment.
how_its_made:
This project utilizes the frame.js template alongside Next.js, Tailwind CSS (create a beautiful user interface), Supabase (Database), and server-side rendering for efficient and dynamic web development.

The following technologies was used:
- Frames.js: For making frames
- Privy : For onboarding the  users
